representation_fit.evidence: Both screenshots (1280x860, 1440x900) show a block-structured document workbench — structured editing pane, live preview pane, outline, heading chips H2/H3 — matching the brief's single-document/medium-hierarchy/low-density shape; source/app.js:19-29 defines document block types (h2-h4, p, ul, ol, quote, code, callout, divider) and source/data.js seeds one document only.

primary_task_salience.evidence: Default view is split (source/index.html:10 body data-view='split'; '分屏' active in topbar in both screenshots); the editable document blocks fill the central pane with an editable doc title in the topbar (index.html:22), so the edit-document task dominates the initial screen.

time_to_understand.evidence: Pane headers '结构化编辑'/'实时预览', keyboard hint 'Enter 新建块 · Tab 调层级 · Alt+↑↓ 移动' (index.html:63), '与编辑实时同步' chip (index.html:71), stats bar and '结构完好' pill (index.html:24) are all legible at first glance in both screenshots. Model-judged proxy only, not a human-timed measurement.

navigation_cost.evidence: Primary object (the document) is on screen and directly editable at load — zero navigation steps; outline buttons jump both views to a block (app.js:733-736), health pill scrolls to the structure-check panel (index.html:24, app.js:767-773).

context_loss.evidence: Editing is fully in-place in the split view: each input updates the model and re-renders the preview without leaving the screen (app.js:618-639); block insert uses a fixed popover menu, not a separate mode (app.js:484-509); delete/reset show undo toasts (app.js:438, 759-766). No flow requires leaving the document context.

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Permanent chrome is proportionate: topbar controls, outline + structure-check sidebar, status bar (index.html:13-83). The six per-block operation buttons and per-item delete are hidden until hover/focus/selected (styles.css:274-285, 336-343), keeping the canvas uncluttered despite full block manipulation capability.

accessibility.evidence: Receipt fails 4/7 checks: a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size (measurement-summary.json checks). Source shows real effort (:focus-visible outline styles.css:43; aria-labels index.html:22-36; prefers-reduced-motion styles.css:504-506), but block-op buttons are 22px tall / 24px min-width (styles.css:286-295), and several permanent texts are 10-10.5px (.type-chip styles.css:263-264, .brand-sub styles.css:73, .doc-kicker styles.css:386), consistent with the target-size and min-type-size failures.

frontend_rework.evidence: All layout checks pass (layout.overflow, layout.responsive_collision, text.truncation) and both screenshots are visually clean at 1280x860 and 1440x900 with no clipping or collision; however the four a11y/type-size receipt failures (checks a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size) imply remediation rework before acceptable quality.

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed '结构化编辑与预览一致' is the app's central design claim: editor and preview render from the same doc model (app.js:1-4 comment, renderPreview app.js:224-236), every keystroke re-renders the preview (app.js:635), a sync chip pulses per render (app.js:232-235, index.html:71), and both screenshots show identical content and ordering in the edit and preview panes (paragraph, lists, quote, H2 sections match).

defects_observed: Receipt a11y.target_size fail — block-op buttons 22px height / min-width 24px, hover-revealed only (source/styles.css:286-295)
Receipt type.min_projected_size fail — several permanent labels at 10-11px (source/styles.css:73, 263-264, 386)
Level/promote-demote and item-delete controls are invisible until hover or focus-within (styles.css:274-285, 343), which plausibly contributes to the focus-order/target-size failures
scores.overall_note: The package presents a coherent single-document structured editor that matches the brief's shape bundle and centers the primary edit task from first paint: the split view (index.html:10) shows the block editor and a preview rendered from the same model (app.js:224-236, 618-639), directly evidencing the acceptance seed of edit/preview consistency in both screenshots. Navigation and context costs are minimal (in-place editing, popover insert menu, undo toasts), and permanent UI surface is restrained via hover-revealed block operations. The clear weakness is accessibility: four of seven receipt checks fail (contrast, focus order, target size, minimum type size), consistent with source-level findings of 22px hover-only controls and 10-11px labels, while all layout checks pass — so the rework exposure is a11y remediation rather than layout repair. Task time, retrieval accuracy, and human preference are not observable in this blind review, and the time-to-understand score is a model-judged proxy, not a human measurement.
